findings.title: Async function calls sync code without await
findings.body: `converted_cents` is an async function that calls `fetch_rate(pair)` without `await`, so the coroutine is returned as-is instead of the rate. This will raise a `TypeError` when the caller tries to use the result. Add `await` before `fetch_rate(pair)`.

findings.title: Floating-point multiplication loses precision
findings.body: Multiplying `amount_cents` (an int) by `rate` (a Decimal) produces a float, which loses precision and may introduce rounding errors. Use `Decimal` arithmetic throughout: convert `amount_cents` to `Decimal` before multiplication and return a `Decimal` or an int derived from it.

summary.problem: The new async function calls a sync function without await and performs imprecise float multiplication.
summary.done_well: The function signature and docstring clearly describe the intended conversion behavior.
